entitymodel.title: Unified Payroll Entity Model - World Class
entitymodel.description: Unified payroll domain model for Apache OFBiz. - Multi-org (organizationPartyId) - Multi-currency (currencyUomId + FX rates) - HR references (Party/UserLogin) - Accounting integration (GL/Invoice) - Export (PDF/CSV/HTML) + delivery (Email/SMS/Portal) - Compliance and audit tracking NOTE: No <index> tags included (as requested).
